Admission auction: each epoch auctions 1000 tokens; only holders transact, pricing out bulk fake identities.

Top 1000 bids each win a soulbound token struck like a ferrous medallion — worthless to resell. Honest holders recover 40% of their bid; a karst of clones that never works forfeits its bid.

Cost: at clearing price 5, 500 fakes cost 2500 and forfeit 1500 with zero revenue. Anti-bypass: bidders capped at 3 tokens, bids above 10x reserve refunded second-price, tokens expire per epoch — so no lotus of sleepers can be stockpiled.
